how: Candidates came from GitHub repository searches (gh search repos) per app kind and stack; every entry's licence, stars, last-push date and archived flag were then read from the GitHub REST API (gh api repos/OWNER/NAME) on 2026-11-10, and licence files the API could not classify were read by hand; nothing was cloned or run.
second_check: 2026-11-10, a second pass after the search: all 305 repositories were looked up again through the GitHub API. Every one exists; licence, archived flag and star count match the catalog for every repository GitHub can classify. Not checked: what screens each app has, paid services an app depends on, and separate licence files inside sub-folders.
